enterprise.name: Cropping Grains Enterprise
enterprise.description: A cropping grains enterprise: emissions from crop production, plus the farm's energy, waste and upstream (Scope 3) emissions.

customSheets.name: Results
customSheets.description: The single enterprise-wide results tab, unique to this enterprise. Module Results tabs are NOT imported; this sheet reads each module's result cells directly by named range.

customSheets.name: Input - Enterprise
customSheets.description: Optional enterprise-level input sheet for values shared across modules. Imported module input sheets are kept as-is alongside this one.

customSheets.name: Input - Fert Prod System
customSheets.description: Non-user editable inputs that take values from the imported 'Input - Crop' sheet

modules.comment: Grain cropping has its own fertiliser production systems inputs.

Grain cropping only needs the crop residue chain. The workbook now ships crop- and pasture-specific leaching/runoff sheets, so this imports Input - Crop plus 6.1 Crop residue N2O, 6.3 Leach runoff crop and 6.4 Residue burning (which depends only on the crop residue sheet and Input - Crop, not on any pasture sheet or Input - Pasture). The pasture input, 6.2 Pasture residue N2O is not required. A bare string (like the entries above) imports every sheet the registry lists for that module; this object form subsets them.
Scope 3 contains livestock purchase inputs that are not required here as there is already a livestock purchases module in Pasture Beef herd movement

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
